(1) coordinate_migrator.py/install_block_updater.py's locale-guard, protected-page (auto_updatable:false), and fenced-block-detection logic are directly reusable and should NOT be reimplemented. title: Investigate and resolve the 3d/java systemic API-accuracy defect blocking 370 files (Finding F-13 / backlog ST-040)

determination: Root cause: GltfSaveOptions/GltfLoadOptions genuinely have no setContentType()/setFlipCoordinateSystem() methods -- FileContentType is a GltfSaveOptions constructor parameter, not a setter; coordinate-flipping exists only on StlSaveOptions/StlLoadOptions; the real buffer method is setBufferFile(), not setBufferFilePrefix(). Confirmed via direct upstream source read, not api_surface.json re-inspection alone -- api_surface.json was already correct. All 11 blocked English files (7 blog, 3 kb, 1 products) hand-corrected via S-73 manual-edit, each change grounded in a cited real method signature; audit.py confirmed 0 FAIL per file after every edit. Also discovered (not yet filed as its own backlog item) a residual attach_evidence.py --force bug: its top-level evidence.apis aggregation doesn't fully clear a stale entry even after the section-level source is corrected -- worked around per-file, ~9 recurrences.
